Middle East Conflict
Escalations involving the US, Israel, and Iran 
threaten the property sector by potentially 
increasing energy costs and inflation, 
thereby reducing overseas investment and 
purchasing power.

The Thai Baht has reached a four -year high 
of approximately 31.00 THB per USD, 
driven by rising gold prices amid Middle 
East tensions and improved investor 
confidence following the February general 
elections. This strong currency poses a 
significant hurdle for overseas clients.
Worldwide Economy
Global economic growth is expected to 
decline in 2026 due to the end of a surge 
from businesses rushing shipments before 
last year ’s trade tariffs. Consequently, 
increased costs and trade barriers are 
affecting the sales of Thai property, 
especially in overseas markets.Global economics are acting as the primary drivers for property sector in 2026
